chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Salat (prayer) is a balance, so whoever fulfils it fully will receive in full."

key_terms.مِيزَانٌ: a balance or measure by which worth is weighed
key_terms.ٱسْتَوْفَى: received in full or took the full due
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the central act of worship being described

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the importance of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith presents salat (prayer) as a measure by which a person's devotion and obedience are weighed. It teaches that whoever performs it properly and completely attains their full share of reward and spiritual benefit.
